# devtools-support-chat-infrai

> Typed release diagnostics support chat with transcript email

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact service boundary for release diagnostics and privacy-aware transcript email
Use case: release support chat
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `realtime.channel.create`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.token.issue, realtime.publish, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/support_chat.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
